summary: A uniformly nonsingular three-bank scalar core and two unit diagonal defects from its dangerous rank-one completion do not force any uniformly large physical diagonal, edge, or fixed-cardinality principal block. The exact family A_m=sum_{j=1}^3 r_j r_j^T has nonzero spectrum {4,2,1}, compressed core M=J_3+diag(1,1,0) with sigma_min(M)=2-sqrt(3), but every physical entry is at most 2/m and every fixed k-by-k principal block has operator norm at most 2k/m. The defects can migrate into diffuse grouped rank-one squares. This refutes only the physical-harvest mechanism, not QFORM; a target-valid Gaussian witness for the same matrices is uniformly paid after group aggregation with density at most pi.
next_implication: Develop a grouped-defect recursion or energy inequality that pays aggregate bank coupling before coordinate selection and terminates or routes to an existing paid branch under s_3(A)>=1.
